wikitext: {{MissingInfo|1|java}} [[File:Tonio Path to the Peak.png|250px|thumb|Tonio]] '''Tonio''' is a character from ''[[Pokémon: Path to the Peak]]'' that appeared in ''[[PTP02|Regionals]]''. He was Ava's first opponent during the [[Play! Pokémon#Regional Championships|Regional Championships]]. ==History== In ''[[PTP02|Regionals]]'', Tonio played the first regional championship match against [[Ava]], and despite being more experienced than her in the competition and Ava's insecurity, Tonio was easily defeated by her. He was later seen cheering her on in the finals against [[Celestine]] and took a picture with Ava, [[Joshua (Path to the Peak)|Joshua]] and Celestine. ==Deck== Tonio uses a {{e|Colorless}} deck, focused on {{TCG|Bidoof}}.
